EOMasters News

New Blog: Satellite Boom - It is Getting Crowdy!

Have you ever looked up at the night sky and wondered how many satellites are actually orbiting our blue marble?

In this blog post, I have a look at the benefits and costs of satellite constellations, the current and future trends, the existing and potential solutions, and the need for more regulation and cooperation in the space domain.

  • Satellite Boom - It is Getting Crowdy!

First Video Tutorial on YouTube

The first video tutorial is now available on YouTube. It shows how you can use Excel to easily do bulk processing without writing complex scripts. 

  • EO Data Processing with SNAP and Excel!

EO and RS News

Sustainable Satellite Operations

What if satellites could be repaired, refuelled, or upgraded while in orbit? This is the vision of In-Orbit Servicing (IOS), a new field of space exploration that could revolutionise the way satellites are designed and operated1. ESA has been leading the way in IOS research, collaborating with industry partners to develop Europe’s first IOS missions2. Find out how these missions could extend the life and capabilities of satellites in low-Earth orbit and geostationary orbit, and what challenges and opportunities lie ahead for IOS in the near future. Read more in this article from ESA.

  • ESA - ESA moves ahead with In-Orbit Servicing missions

New ESA Earth Observation Science Strategy

ESA is developing a new Earth observation science strategy to address the complex and urgent challenges facing our planet, such as climate change, natural disasters, and food and water security. The strategy will focus more on understanding the Earth as a system, using the latest advances in technology, data analytics and modelling.

  • ESA - New strategy to keep pace with our changing world 

BiDS - Big Data from Space 2023

The 6th BiDS conference takes place in Vienna from the 6th to the 9th of July. During the event there are 7 main topics discussed:

  1. Big data-driven transformation in policy and society

  2. Cross-domain applications

  3. Ethics, equity, and trust in Big Data driven policies

  4. Cloud-native and digital innovation

  5. New processing paradigms exploiting multi-source data

  6. New methods and technologies for enabling foresight

  7. Disruptive technologies

This takes place in Birds of a Feather sessions, Lightning talks, Exhibitions and Demos, Hackathons and a Pangeo Code Sprint.

Participation is free of charge and registration will open on September 14th.

  • BiDS | Big Data from Space 2023

  • BiDS23 flyer

Registration for FRINGE 2023 is Open

Registration is open for the 12th International Workshop on “Advances in the Science and Applications of SAR Interferometry and Sentinel-1 InSAR” - FRINGE 2023

  • FRINGE 2023 (esa.int)

Sentinel-3 World Fire Atlas Published

The Sentinel-3 World Fire Atlas has been developed by the European Space Agency processing the Sentinel-3A SLSTR Level 1b data containing two dedicated channels (F1 and F2) for fire and high temperature events at global scale during night-time.

  • Sentinel-3 World Fire Atlas

Software Updates

SMOS Tools updates

Two SMOS related tools have been released.

The new Matlab library (RWAPI / SMOSRWLib) to read and write SMOS products and auxiliary files is available.

The SMOS Data Viewer is available in an updated version. The Data Viewer provides a quick and easy way to view SMOS products and auxiliary files used for Level 1 and 2 product generation. The new version offers improved visualisation functionality for AUX_OTT, AUX_DTBXY and AUX_SSS auxiliary files.

  • SMOS Tools updates

  • RWAPI / SMOSRWLib

  • SMOS Data Viewer

That's it for this issue. I hope you enjoyed this collection of EO news. Stay tuned for the next edition, which will arrive in your inbox in about two weeks.
